**Problem:** "most boxes ship free" implies that most orders or subscription boxes come to more than £25. Nothing in the allowlist or this chat says so. It's an invented proportion, and it also doesn't follow from the free-delivery threshold, since the threshold says nothing about how many orders clear it. If some subscription boxes cost under £25, the line is misleading about delivery cost.

**Slop and structure check:** No banned words, no em-dashes, no exclamation marks, no rhetorical-question opener. The opening line is vague but acceptable.

**Suggested fix:**

> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

If you can show that most boxes are over £25, send me the source and I can reinstate the claim. Otherwise, use the version above.
